legend: Nastya received one more array on her birthday, this array can be used to play a traditional Byteland game on it. However, to play the game the players should first select such a subsegment of the array that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70233378c7a99d05113a43e5a2289ff347e1084f.png), where p is the product of all integers on the given array, s is their sum, and k is a given constant for all subsegments.
Nastya wonders how many subsegments of the array fit the described conditions. A subsegment of an array is several consecutive integers of the array.
input: The first line contains two integers n and k (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·105, 1 ≤ k ≤ 105), where n is the length of the array and k is the constant described above.
The second line contains n integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 108) — the elements of the array.
output: In the only line print the number of subsegments such that the ratio between the product and the sum on them is equal to k.
note: In the first example the only subsegment is [1]. The sum equals 1, the product equals 1, so it suits us because ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/627b2899a459d42fe3b2ca04fc812d4132b5f2ca.png).

There are two suitable subsegments in the second example — [6, 3] and [3, 8, 1]. Subsegment [6, 3] has sum 9 and product 18, so it suits us because ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/107ecd38fde9817d6565e2059ccd064562470543.png). Subsegment [3, 8, 1] has sum 12 and product 24, so it suits us because ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8abc1793efa3061313ddd52d670a94b430133564.png).

note.ai: 在第一个样例中，唯一的子数组是 [1]。其和等于 1，乘积也等于 1，因此它满足条件，因为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/627b2899a459d42fe3b2ca04fc812d4132b5f2ca.png)。

第二个样例中有两个符合条件的子段——[6, 3] 和 [3, 8, 1]。子段 [6, 3] 的和为 9，乘积为 18，因此它符合要求，因为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/107ecd38fde9817d6565e2059ccd064562470543.png)。子段 [3, 8, 1] 的和为 12，乘积为 24，因此它符合要求，因为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8abc1793efa3061313ddd52d670a94b430133564.png)。

legend.ai: Nastya 在生日时又收到一个数组，这个数组可以用来进行传统的 Byteland 游戏。然而，要进行游戏，玩家首先应选择数组的一个子数组，使得 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/70233378c7a99d05113a43e5a2289ff347e1084f.png)，其中 p 是给定数组中所有整数的乘积，s 是它们的和，k 是对所有子数组都给定的常数。
Nastya 想知道数组中有多少个子数组满足所描述的条件。数组的子数组是数组中连续的若干个整数。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 n 和 k（1 ≤ n ≤ 2·105，1 ≤ k ≤ 105），其中 n 是数组的长度，k 是上文所述的常数。
第二行包含 n 个整数 a1， a2， ...， an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 108），表示数组中的元素。

output.ai: 在唯一一行中输出满足其乘积与和的比值等于 k 的子数组数量。
